description: This file provides utility functions for handling date and time, including timezone resolution, timestamp normalization, and time formatting, with system-specific detection for 12/24-hour formats.

methods.name: resolveUserTimezone
methods.description: Resolves the user's timezone based on a provided configuration string or system defaults.

methods.name: resolveUserTimeFormat
methods.description: Determines the user's preferred time format (12 or 24-hour) based on preference or system settings.

methods.name: normalizeTimestamp
methods.description: Converts various raw timestamp inputs into a standardized object with milliseconds and ISO string.

methods.name: withNormalizedTimestamp
methods.description: Augments a given object with normalized timestamp fields based on raw input.

methods.name: formatUserTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a human-readable string according to user preferences and system locale.
